title: How MOQ and slab pricing work for pet retailers
excerpt: A plain explanation of minimum order quantities and quantity slabs, and how to pick the slab that suits your shop.
body:
## What is an MOQ

The minimum order quantity (MOQ) is the smallest number of pieces of a product we can supply in one order. Each product has its own MOQ.

## What is a slab

A slab is a quantity range with its own price per piece. Order more pieces and you move into a higher slab with a lower price per piece.

## Choosing a slab

Look at how fast a product sells in your shop, then pick the quantity you can sell before the next restock. [ADD YOUR OWN GUIDANCE AND EXAMPLES HERE]

title: Checklist: what to ask a pet product supplier before your first order
excerpt: Questions worth asking any wholesale pet supplier, from MOQ and GST invoices to dispatch times.
body:
## Before you order

- What is the MOQ for each product?
- Do prices change with quantity?
- Is a GST tax invoice provided?
- How long does dispatch take?
- What is the returns policy?
